# Do you qualify as a real estate professional, and what is it worth?

> Free calculator: do your hours pass the real estate professional 750-hour and more-than-half tests, are your rentals materially participated in, and what is turning a rental loss non-passive worth against the $25,000 allowance? Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
